lessons_used: Evidence is still thin across all change types; at least 2 tests of a kind are required to establish a rule.
Predictions were consistently too high across all change types compared to noise-corrected measurements.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen changes (only 1 test, which performed worse at -4.8% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish new_screen changes (only 1 test, which showed no clear effect at +1.7% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in reorder changes (only 1 test, which showed no clear effect at -0.5% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish redesign changes (only 1 test, which performed worse at -6.3% after noise correction).
carried_retests: New System Tray & Desktop Guide Screen

candidates.title: Choose Path Centered Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen with a centered stage layout presenting starter options clearly.
candidates.why: The choose_path step drops 23.8% of users with a high mean duration of 514s.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Pet Experience
choose_path.body: Choose a pre-made companion or build your own custom desktop pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns the path selection screen while retaining options for adopting pre-made or building custom pets.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path has moderate drop (23.8%) and high mean duration; evidence comes only from funnel, and redesigns carry high cost.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Spawn Guidance Screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen right before waiting completes showing visual instructions on where the pet appears on the taskbar.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to show on desktop or the app stalling.

new_spawn_guide.headline: Locating Your Pet on Desktop
new_spawn_guide.body: Your pet will spawn near your system tray once loading completes.

guard.reason: Adding a new guidance screen inside onboarding before waiting completes is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home step drop is 18.7% supported by emails, but new screen changes have shown negative or flat results in past tests.

candidates.title: Interactive Photo Styling Customization Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a stage layout with photo picker and preview components during photo upload.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has only 60.9% conversion and users report custom pets looking wrong or failing.

upload_photos.headline: Customize Your Pet Appearance
upload_photos.body: Adjust photo framing and style filters for your custom pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns the photo upload flow while preserving its core function.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest drop (39.1%) and direct support reports, though full interactive flow requires heavy effort.

candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Adoption Certificate
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding sequence so sign-in happens after adoption certificate creation.
candidates.why: Signing in early causes 27.1% drop-off and support issues with missing pets on re-auth.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet
sign_in.body: Create or sign in to your account to save your newly adopted pet permanently.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign_in loses 27.1% and has support backing, but reordering in past tests showed -0.5% effect.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick Reference Card
candidates.change: Switch home intro to a checklist layout displaying key pet interaction shortcuts.
candidates.why: Multiple users emailed support asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Essential Desktop Pet Controls
home_intro.body: Learn the basics to interact with your pet on screen.

components.text: Double-click pet to open chat window

guard.reason: Home intro overlay layout changes inside onboarding are allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drops 35.2% and support mails ask for controls; layout change is moderate cost.

candidates.title: Live Generation Progress Wait Info
candidates.change: Display dynamic progress bar and estimated time on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a long median time of 201s and mean of 2336s.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet Desktop Assets
waiting.body: We are assembling animations and interactions for your pet.

guard.reason: Adding dynamic progress and time estimates during real pet rendering wait is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home wait time is very high (201s median), progress UI directly addresses long wait transparency.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Name Validation Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit explanatory hint on the adoption certificate screen about name binding to accounts.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and users report pet state loss after authentication.

adoption_certificate.hint: Your pet name is locked to your account so you can restore it anytime.
adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate

guard.reason: Adds account binding hint to the adoption certificate screen without losing its core purpose.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop step (adoption 39.1%) backed by support complaints; minimal implementation cost.

candidates.title: Completion Desktop Shortcut Incentive
candidates.change: Display a playful badge on the final home intro screen highlighting unlocked starter emotes.
candidates.why: 35.2% of users drop off at the final onboarding screen before reaching completion.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Companion Home
home_intro.body: Complete setup to unlock exclusive starter pet emotes!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions unlocked starter pet emote extras, violating Rule 3.

candidates.title: Multi-Account Pet Recovery Hint
candidates.change: Add a hint on sign_in explaining that pets are bound to the specific sign-in account email.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) cited missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Make sure to sign in with the same email you used previously to keep your pets.
sign_in.headline: Sign In to Desktop Pets

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Story Intro Pet Features Refresh
candidates.change: Update story screen text and button label to set clear expectations before path choice.
candidates.why: Initial path choice stage drops 23.8% of incoming users.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Pets
story.body: Your new virtual companion lives right on your desktop window bar.

guard.reason: Updates story copy while continuing to introduce the desktop pet.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy change addressing initial 23.8% drop on path selection screen.

decisions.title: New System Tray & Desktop Guide Screen

shipped: New System Tray & Desktop Guide Screen
lessons_next: Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, except for Round 6 where the prediction was too low.
finish new_screen changes are effective (+3.6% average after noise correction across 2 tests, with 1 winning test).
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen changes (only 1 test, which performed worse at -5.2% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for finish redesign changes (only 1 test, which performed worse at -6.9% after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for sign_in reorder changes (only 1 test, which showed no clear effect at -0.5% after noise correction).
